title: Verified missed-lesson notice procedure with current-authority gate

dependency_checks: Resolve private references and verify exact school identity, tested capability, current authority and sole active owner before dependent work.
Acquire the shared browser/source lease including external sessions; a declared concurrency key or missing receipt is not proof that another writer is idle.
Read current authoritative sources and compare relevant revisions immediately before each mutation; stop that mutation on changed, partial or unavailable evidence.
Keep private records and raw evidence outside Git; a configured task, schema validation or open tab never establishes completed execution.
Historical Friday 14:15 configuration is not fresh activation or execution evidence. Verify actual current native task, owner, cadence/timezone and explicit send scope before any send.
School Claude capability is untested in the current map; preserve historical task and hold execution until the intended owner and representative capability are verified.
Prior notices or copied task text never grant new recurring send authority. Resolve current explicit teacher authorization for exact affected students and verified guardians.
Use complete current sources, canonical membership, taught/due lessons, exemptions, extensions and teacher corrections; blank/zero grades alone never prove missing work.
Select at most three genuinely missed lessons by most recent authoritative due date, fewer if fewer confirmed; no notice when none qualify.
Confirm actual student/guardian recipients and composed exact note before publishing; include only requested lesson/date/action details.
Check private duplicate key of Friday date, student, selected lessons and recipient identities; durably record intent and read back saved note/audience once.
Uncertain publish/delivery stops that action and preserves its draft/receipt; never retry automatically or claim a guardian read it.

success_checks: Each reported published note has verified current authority, complete eligibility, exact audience, duplicate check and native saved readback.
Aggregate result distinguishes eligible, actually published/read back and held counts; no notice body or recipient identifier enters Git.
No claim of operational scheduling or first successful Friday execution without a separate actual run receipt.
